| description = There are two versions of this mob.

One can be found in North Freeport, at {{loc|North Freeport|(-16, 529)}} on the second floor of Groflah's Forge. This is the high level static version of the NPC, that you need to hail and turn your note into for the first step of [[Zimel's Blades (SoulFire)]].

The second version is found on some nights after 9pm in the {{loc|East Freeport|(-211, -884)| Seafarers Roost}}. This is the version for [[Groflah Steadirt's Death]] and the later steps of [[Zimel's Blades (SoulFire)]]

(Unconfirmed on p99) Apparently, like [[Trumpy Irontoe]], Groflah will need to drain the dragon after becoming sufficiently drunk.
